scope: Results describe the supplied sample, not model intelligence.

methodology.unit: One supplied entry; nested and flat message formats are both included.
methodology.classification: Each entry has one primary task category. Operational rendering failures do not demonstrate visual-design or coding ability.
methodology.volume_rule: Volume measures demand only. Weakness requires explicit friction; user-reported failures are not independently verified.

rating_definitions.Critical: Repeated explicit operational blockage makes remediation a high priority within this sample.
rating_definitions.Weak: Explicit quality friction with at least two relevant entries.
rating_definitions.Developing: Observed partial success with unresolved limitations and at least two relevant entries.
rating_definitions.Covered: Demonstrated successful outcomes with at least two relevant entries.
rating_definitions.Not measured: Fewer than two relevant entries, or no outcome evidence sufficient to rate capability.

strongest_measured_task_category.reason: There are no successful answers or tool outcomes to establish a strongest capability. Research verification has four evidence-oriented requests but no demonstrated verification.

categories.evidence: Four requests require primary sources or citations; no answers or verification outcomes are supplied. Demand is observed, competence is not.
One review request falls below the two-entry minimum.
No implementation or code-review entries; command troubleshooting is classified as tool execution.
One of three writing requests explicitly reports a prior tone mismatch and generic copy. This supports a narrow voice-adaptation weakness, not a general writing judgment.

All four relevant requests explicitly report operational failures: two render timeouts, one permission denial, and one server-tool error. Repeated blockage supports remediation priority; root cause is unknown.

surprising_weakness.finding: Operational reliability is the clearest observed gap, despite the substantial demand for research verification.
surprising_weakness.evidence: Four of four tool-execution entries report failure; two describe render timeouts, including one explicitly recurring timeout.
surprising_weakness.caveat: These are user reports. Environment failures may explain the friction; agent fault and recovery ability are unmeasured.

recommendations_status: Relevant skills, not confirmed missing installations. Effectiveness and installation status have not been audited.

recommended_skills.reason: Relevant to diagnosing permission and tool-environment failures before attributing them to task skill.
Relevant to the explicit tone mismatch and generic-copy complaint.
Relevant to matching the register of recipient-facing messages.
Relevant to testing whether proposed skill changes improve repeatable failure cases before adoption.
